subject: Alphacorp order form: commitment waterfall, invoice entity swap & VAT handling
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <payments@alphacorp.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Johnson <procurement@alphacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form questions — invoice entity / VAT / minimums

Hi Ava,

We reviewed the latest order form (received from Ben). A few quick asks from finance/procurement so we can route the PO:

- Alphacorp needs invoices to be issued to Alphacorp, Inc. (US entity). Can Redwood confirm which legal entity will appear on invoices and whether we can swap invoice recipient at signature?
- We have a regional VAT question — some services may be supplied to EU subsidiaries. Can you confirm whether Redwood will gross up VAT or if Alphacorp is responsible for reverse-charge / VAT registration?
- Minimum commit waterfall: Procurement wants a simple schedule for the first 12 months (quarterly triggers and when invoice credits apply). Current table is a bit dense for finance.

Can you please provide a short note and a redlined order form (if needed) so we can attach with our PO? We'd like to close this week if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Payments & Billing
Alphacorp

Attachments: Alphacorp_PO.pdf (PDF, 124KB)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <payments@alphacorp.com>
Cc: Mark Johnson <procurement@alphacorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoice entity / VAT / minimums

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below: 

1) Invoice entity: Redwood issues invoices from Redwood Inference, Inc. (US). We can support an invoice recipient change at signature where Alphacorp will be listed as the bill-to; however, the underlying remittance/legal entity remains Redwood Inference, Inc. I've attached a one-page confirmation we can include in the order form appendix.

2) VAT / reverse charge: We do not automatically gross up for VAT. For EU-supplied services, typical flow is that the customer self-assesses under reverse charge. If Alphacorp needs Redwood to register and gross up VAT, we need to discuss which jurisdictions and add a VAT handling clause (possible surcharge).

3) Minimum commit waterfall: I converted the current table into a simple quarterly waterfall with triggers and invoice offsets — see redline draft (attached). Proposal: quarterly invoicing in arrears with a credit applied if usage exceeds commit and an automatic true-up at quarter end. If that works, I'll ask Ben and Kimberly to finalize language for the order form appendix.

Next steps: Ben will confirm commercial terms (discount bands) and Kimberly will handle the small MSA/order form redlines related to invoice recipient and VAT language. Expect a redline back by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redline_orderform_v3.docx (Word, 42KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <payments@alphacorp.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Order form questions — invoice entity / VAT / minimums

Elena, Mark — looping in the commercial confirmation. Bottom-line items:

- Pricing bands: The rates in Appendix A remain the same. If Alphacorp wants to shift invoice entity or require Redwood to gross up VAT, that would be an exceptional change to pricing; I can provide an estimated surcharge if you identify the jurisdictions.
- Minimum commit waterfall (proposal summary): 1) Q1: 100k tokens committed — invoiced monthly; 2) Q2: commit steps + true-up; credits applied monthly and reconciled quarterly. I'll add an example calculation to make this clear for procurement.

If we get sign-off on invoice recipient swap (bill-to change only) and Alphacorp confirms handling of VAT via reverse charge, we can proceed without price adjustments. Otherwise, we will need a short appendix for VAT handling and an adjusted PO flow.

I'll send the example invoice calc and updated Appendix A in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_example_q1.xlsx (referenced)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoice entity / VAT / minimums

Hi all — I reviewed the requested changes and drafted two short redlines:

- Section "Invoice Recipient": allows bill-to substitution on the face of the invoice to match customer PO but specifies that Redwood Inference, Inc. remains the remittance/legal entity. This preserves accounting/withholding obligations.
- Section "VAT and Taxes": states that Redwood will not gross up VAT unless explicitly agreed in writing and that Alphacorp will be responsible for VAT where applicable under reverse charge. If Alphacorp requires Redwood to register and remit VAT in specific jurisdictions, that will be treated as a contract variation with fee adjustments.

I've attached redline_orderform_v3.docx (tracked changes) and included comments on scope where a surcharge may apply. Please confirm if Alphacorp accepts the bill-to-only swap plus reverse-charge stance. If they ask Redwood to take on VAT remittance, we need procurement to specify jurisdictions and expected volumes before we propose a surcharge.

Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline_orderform_v3.docx (Word, 58KB); tax_certificate_Alphacorp.pdf (PDF, 87KB)

Kimberly — thanks for the quick redlines, those look reasonable. Confirming Alphacorp's position:

- We are fine with Redwood Inference, Inc. as remittance entity and a bill-to swap to Alphacorp, Inc. on invoice headers. That meets our PO/ERP mapping needs.
- We will handle VAT under reverse charge for EU-supplied services. We do not expect Redwood to register or gross up VAT at this time.
- Regarding the waterfall: procurement prefers that invoice credits are applied monthly and reconciled quarterly. Please include the example calculation Ben mentioned in the Appendix so our AP team has a sample line item.

If you can send the final redline (clean copy + tracked) and a one-page example invoice for Q1, we will attach to the PO and issue signatures. Looking to execute by end of week.

Mark Johnson
Head of Procurement, Alphacorp
